name: SmoothUI · Dynamic Island

description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 SmoothUI 提供 228 个带 Motion 动画的 React 组件与 primitives，可按 shadcn/ui 模式复制代码或通过一条命令安装；另有 Blocks（hero、pricing、FAQ 等页面区块）与 Templates（如 Chat Template 整页模板）。站点还提供无需认证的公开 API 与 MCP 接入，供 AI 助手检索和安装组件。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by SmoothUI (https://smoothui.dev/).
Technology stack: react, tailwind, typescript, motion.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
